info.name: CloudVault Upload Notifier
info.summary: Report file uploads and storage events to CloudVault Watchtower
info.description:
CloudVault Upload Notifier listens to Nextcloud filesystem events and reports upload success/failure to the CloudVault Watchtower service, which routes them to connected Telegram users.
Events emitted: * UPLOAD_COMPLETED - a file was successfully uploaded/created * UPLOAD_FAILED - an upload failed: started-but-never-completed (tracked via pending writes) or rejected by files_antivirus (tracked via oc_activity)
Configuration (occ config:app:set upload_notifier ...): * watchtower_url - Watchtower event endpoint (default http://127.0.0.1:9191/api/events) * failure_ttl - seconds before a pending upload is considered failed (default 600) * av_last_activity_id - high-water mark of processed antivirus rejection activities (do not touch normally) * event_UPLOAD_COMPLETED / event_UPLOAD_FAILED - per-event toggle (yes/no)
info.author: CloudVault
